description: Every retained ground term \(t\in S\) evaluates to its own class \([t]\) in the specified positive-relation model, which retains the ground-equality function map.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.model_term_value.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Problem L)
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L)
  (ht : t ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.support Γ) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim t = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.classOf Γ t ht
